result.title: PATTERN Can Be Solved from Memory: Generator-Aware Baselines for Synthetic Node Classification
result.summary: PATTERN, a synthetic node-classification benchmark still used to rank graph networks, plants a random subgraph in a random host graph and asks which nodes belong to it. Its generator draws 100 patterns once and plants the same ones in every split, so each test graph carries a pattern that also appears in 100 training graphs. A matcher that reads these patterns off the training labels and looks them up in each test graph reaches 99.2 class-weighted accuracy with no trained parameters, against 89.8 for the best published model. Inference under the generator without the patterns reaches 86.8. Two published models, CKGConv and GRIT, score lower on patterns they have not seen: on new graphs with fresh patterns both fall below this pattern-blind predictor, and withholding patterns from CKGConv's training lowers its accuracy on the test graphs that carry them. Training CKGConv with a new pattern in every graph raises its accuracy on fresh patterns by about 2 points, to the level of the pattern-blind predictor, at some cost on the reused patterns. The same kind of inference under the generator matches the best published result on CLUSTER and, without any training, scores above every published result we found on Minesweeper's released board. We recommend that synthetic benchmarks report scores on fresh templates beside reused ones, publish baselines built from their generators, and state how their metric is weighted and pooled.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出现有合成节点分类基准 PATTERN 的生成器在训练与测试划分中复用同一批 pattern，因而可仅从训练标签读出 pattern 并在测试图中查找，无需任何训练参数即达 99.2 加权准确率，超过已发表模型；据此建议在新模板上评测、公开由生成器构造的基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「模型是否真的使用任务信息，还是走了记忆捷径」的诊断与「fresh vs reused 模板」评测协议，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 是否真正承载视觉证据、是否发生视觉旁路，以及设计反捷径对照基线提供可核查的借鉴。
